subject: fix(xpu): stabilize Qwen GDN prefill and mixed scheduling

requirement.arithmetic_grid: Keep eligible text-only, non-speculative XPU Qwen GDN prefills in mamba_cache_mode=none on an absolute 64-token arithmetic grid. Preserve final tails, checkpoint/cache boundaries, and progress with concurrent decodes. Avoid applying the new grid to generic GDN, non-XPU, multimodal, speculative, or encoder-decoder profiles.
requirement.mixed_batches: When ordinary one-token cached decodes and prefills share a contiguous decode-first native GDN batch, keep decode rows on their standalone arithmetic path instead of the prefill arithmetic path.
requirement.mechanism: Distinct Qwen GDN backend identity exposes get_required_prefill_chunk_size; scheduler separates arithmetic alignment from cache alignment; XPU wrapper passes a tightly gated split_mixed_non_spec keyword to the paired native operator.
requirement.current_host_applicability: The deployed Brutus V2/DFlash2 multimodal profile does not activate the scheduler's non-speculative text-only arithmetic-grid policy. Mixed split is gated by actual metadata and cannot cover speculative decode batches. Retention protects supported alternative configurations; this audit establishes no current-profile performance improvement.
requirement.later_local_commits: The KVarN feature changes scheduler allocation/accounting and metadata/checkpoint behavior, but does not supersede this grid or mixed native dispatch. _xpu_ops.py, Qwen layer and SSM transfer changes in this commit remain byte-identical through the old final tip.

upstream_coverage.subject: [XPU] [Feature] Adding triton/sycl GDN toggle (#56835)
upstream_coverage.finding: Adds an alternative Triton path while auto still chooses the fused native SYCL GDN op when available. SYCL continues through gdn_attention_core_xpu, whose _xpu_ops.py source is unchanged from v0.32 and lacks split_mixed_non_spec. Switching the whole model to unqualified Triton is not an equivalent demonstrated fix and does not justify deleting native correctness policy. Preserve this upstream selection and do not force SYCL while replaying.

upstream_coverage.subject: [Perf][GDN] Internal prefill checkpoints for the FlashInfer GDN prefill backend (#60050)
upstream_coverage.finding: 64-token FlashInfer checkpoint alignment concerns checkpoint export on the FlashInfer/CUDA path. It is not non-final XPU arithmetic-grid scheduling, nor a native SYCL mixed-batch replacement. Retain the upstream implementation and distinguish cache checkpoint alignment from local arithmetic alignment.

upstream_coverage.subject: [Core][Spec Decode] Lookahead block hashes for EAGLE prefix caching (#61589)
upstream_coverage.finding: Target adds num_hash_lookahead_tokens to checkpoint positions and their fixtures. Preserve all upstream lookahead proof logic when applying local alignment edits; never restore the old complete function or fixtures. This is additive cache correctness, not coverage of the non-speculative grid.

upstream_coverage.subject: [Bugfix][Spec Decode] DFlash/DSpark no longer drop the last prefix-cache block (#54163)
upstream_coverage.finding: Retain upstream speculative block-drop policy. The local arithmetic grid excludes speculation and does not require reinstating the old DFlash trailing-block workaround.

upstream_coverage.subject: [Perf] Fuse the mamba align block-table gather into one Triton kernel (#58737)
upstream_coverage.finding: Changes block-table metadata gathering in attention/backends/utils.py, not scheduler arithmetic partitioning or native GDN dispatch; does not supersede this patch.

upstream_coverage.subject: [Bugfix] Enable inductor batch-invariant mode under VLLM_BATCH_INVARIANT (#61118)
upstream_coverage.finding: Compiler mode does not alter the unchanged fused SYCL custom op or the non-speculative scheduler partition. It does not establish semantic coverage of the local requirements.

disposition_reason: Retain both unmet XPU arithmetic requirements. Narrow the Qwen backend identity override to XPU to remove an unrelated cross-platform compatibility regression discovered during the audit; otherwise retain the small production policy and preserve new upstream checkpoint logic.

Retain XPU block-size recognition and SSM transfer support for the Qwen enum, since the new identity must work throughout those interfaces.

Change QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention.mamba_type to return QWEN_GDN_ATTN only on XPU and delegate to super().mamba_type on other platforms. Update the existing identity test to cover both platform outcomes.
Preserve upstream num_hash_lookahead_tokens checkpoint arguments and fixture fields during replay. Keep upstream FlashInfer checkpoint export and the new SYCL/Triton backend choice.

adaptation_evidence.problem: The old override assigns QWEN_GDN_ATTN globally, although the new scheduling requirement is XPU-only. Qwen4Exp instantiates QwenGatedDeltaNetAttention, but both its NVIDIA and AMD state-copy maps accept GDN_ATTN and SHORT_CONV only and assert on unknown types.
adaptation_evidence.scope: This mapping mismatch also exists in the old stack; it is not newly introduced by v0.33. Narrowing the XPU-only workaround removes that avoidable non-XPU drift. If the maintainer chooses globally distinct identity instead, both maps require an explicit alias and a regression test.
adaptation_evidence.runtime_status: Static call-path finding; no Qwen4Exp model was loaded.

Apply only the arithmetic/cache alignment distinction and required stub fields; preserve target num_hash_lookahead_tokens, checkpoint alignment and speculative block-drop behavior.
